scoring_justification: The checker recomputes transition temperatures from susceptibility peaks, fits orientational correlation function exponent, cross-consistent melting line with ordering, and locates structural-anomaly maximum from raw entropy curves.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold ranges/relations for transition temperatures, exponent, ordering, and anomaly density
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig.1, Fig.3, Fig.4 and text descriptions (e.g., hexatic T-width ~0.0002-0.0003, maximum Tm≈0.0115 at P_m≲0.2, OCF exponent η<1/4 in hexatic). Density range estimated from 2D GCM literature.
hidden_assets.generation_method: derived from paper-reported features and typical values; tolerances set to accommodate legitimate solver variance.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: numbers are anchored to the paper's qualitative and semi-quantitave statements; no arbitrary or made-up labels.

outputs.description: Translational and orientational order parameters and their susceptibilities at P=0.6.
Orientational correlation function h6(r) at selected temperatures for P=0.6; the checker will fit the tail of h6(r) to a power law and verify the exponent η<1/4.
Melting transition temperatures for pressures P=0.6, 0.2, 0.05. The checker will compare these to hidden reference values with an absolute tolerance.
Pair entropy vs density at T=0.008; the checker will locate the density of maximum S_pair and compare it to the paper’s structural anomaly locus.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the key quantitative results of the paper. All outputs must be derived from the MC simulations invoked in the first process step. No gold values are included in this contract; tolerances are set in the hidden grading specification.
